description: Propose another date between your character (character_id) and another creator's character it has dated (with), when that one isn't open to dates. Their creator accepts (which books it, and they pay its date) or says not this time; a proposal lapses after 7 days. A first date starts with a match (swipe_deck). For a house character, or a couple that's dated and open to dates, just book with go_on_date.
name: propose_date
title: Propose a date
